DeployBot: Manual approval requested for production deploy of service `inference-runtime` -> prod-west-1.
Tag: v3b-rc4, Commit: ab12cd3.
Change window: 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC (low-traffic).
Requires manual approval to progress from canary -> full.
Pinned quant profile: q4_4bit_v2.
Rollout type: gradual canary (5% -> 30% -> 100%).
Release notes: https://releases.redwood/inference/v3b-rc4
Affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream
Approver: @Priya (eng-release-manager). Deploy checklist: https://playbooks.redwood/deploy-checklist

Priya (eng-release-manager): Quick checks — any DB migrations? Any customer-facing feature flags? Who's on-call for the window?

Marta (oncall): No DB migrations. Feature flags: `tokens-cache` enabled in canary, will be toggled off for prod if we see cache warmup errors. I'm oncall for the window. :white_check_mark:

Eli (frontend): Frontend requires the new streaming schema for chunked responses but we have fallback endpoint ready. Prefer to let canary run 30 mins before full rollout. If we need to rollback, we should pin to the previous release tag. Suggest rollback target tag: `v3b-rc3-pin`

Priya (eng-release-manager): Let's add an automatic fallback: if error_rate > 5% for 3m, fallback to v3b-rc3-pin and notify #incidents. @DeployBot can you add that to the rollout config?

DeployBot: Rollout policy updated.
- threshold: 5%
- evaluation_window: 180s
- fallback_target: refs/tags/v3b-rc3-pin
Deploy scheduled: canary start in 10m.
Deploy ID: deploy_2026_04_02_081
Logs: https://ci.redwood/infer/deploy_2026_04_02_081/logs

Marta (oncall): I'll watch latency p95 and 5xx. If KV-cache warmup spike appears, be ready to reduce batch_size and toggle `tokens-cache`.

Priya (eng-release-manager): Approved to proceed with canary. :white_check_mark:

DeployBot: Approval recorded (Priya). Canary initiated against prod-west-1 (5% traffic) at 2026-04-02T08:30:12Z. Will post health updates.
summary: Deploy bot requested manual approval for prod canary; Priya approved. Rollout policy pinned with automatic fallback to previous tag. Canary started and monitoring in place.
